verdict.rationale: Jules documents two oversight knobs of its own. One is an optional plan-approval gate, which a session may or may not require. The other is an API `automationMode` field that controls whether a PR is created automatically (by default it is not). Together these give coarse control over what proceeds without manual confirmation, but they are binary per-session or per-API settings rather than a documented tiered autonomy model. missing for 10: an explicit multi-level autonomy or permission tier system, lead- or org-level policy configuration, per-action controls (e.g., commands, file edits, pushes), documentation of how plan-approval requirements are configured, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can set tiered autonomy levels controlling what an agent can do without manual confirmation
